# Aria Kianzad

> Brand strategist and copywriter. Website: [ariakianzad.github.io](https://ariakianzad.github.io/)

Aria Kianzad is an independent brand strategist and copywriter. The work has
two disciplines: brand strategy (positioning, differentiation, brand voice)
and copywriting (messaging, web copy, naming). The working principle is
simple: understand what a brand should stand for and why it deserves to be
chosen, then write language that expresses that clearly.

## Site

A single static page (no tracking, no analytics, no forms, no backend).
Sections, in order:

- Hero: what Aria does, with a strategist's index of the three ideas behind
  the headline (positioning, relevance, expression).
- Perspective (#perspective): fewer, clearer decisions over more output.
- Disciplines (#disciplines): 01 Brand Strategy, 02 Copywriting.
- Approach (#approach): clarity before volume; difference needs a reason;
  words are part of the strategy.
- Rexo (#rexo): the independent studio Aria founded in 2024, at
  [rexo.agency](https://rexo.agency/)
- About (#about): how Aria thinks.
- Contact (#contact): email [kianzadaria@gmail.com](mailto:kianzadaria@gmail.com)
